run_Triangulator_forward: run the Triangulator forward method to conduct 3D triangulation and bundle adjustment
run_Triangulator_triangulate_tracks_and_: run the triangulate_tracks_and_BA method to triangulate tracks and perform global bundle adjustment
run_find_best_initial_pair: run find_best_initial_pair to select the best image pair for initial 3D point cloud triangulation
build_Triangulator_module: build a Triangulator nn.Module instance for VGGSfM 3D reconstruction with configurable camera parameters
test_Triangulator_forward: test the Triangulator forward pipeline with predicted cameras, tracks, visibility, and images
